title: End-to-End Revenue
subtitle: Cycle Management
description: Our comprehensive revenue cycle management (RCM) process ensures accuracy and compliance at every stage. We manage patient demographics, insurance verification, charge entry, medical coding, claim submission, denial management, and payment posting with strict attention to detail.

title: Insurance Eligibility
subtitle: Verification & Prior Authorization
description: Insurance eligibility issues are one of the leading causes of claim denials. At PhysicianMeds, we verify patient coverage and benefits upfront, confirm pre-authorization requirements, and communicate financial responsibilities clearly. This proactive approach reduces rejections and improves reimbursement success.

title: Accurate Medical Coding
subtitle: & Charge Entry
description: Correct coding is essential for clean claims. Our certified billing specialists use the latest ICD-10, CPT, and HCPCS codes to match services provided. We regularly audit charge entry for accuracy, reducing costly errors and ensuring compliance with payer guidelines.

title: Claim Scrubbing
subtitle: & Fast Submission
description: Before submission, every claim undergoes thorough claim scrubbing to identify errors such as missing data, incorrect modifiers, or invalid codes. Our team then submits claims promptly within payer deadlines, improving turnaround times and boosting your practice’s cash flow.

title: Payment Posting
subtitle: & Denial Management
description: Our billing team ensures accurate and timely payment posting, reconciliation, and reporting. If underpayments or denials occur, we immediately investigate, appeal when necessary, and track claim progress to maximize collections. Patients also receive clear and easy-to-understand statements, improving transparency and satisfaction.
